selection_rule: All four previously inspected P29 development tasks at the eighth-response boundary, including the task without any applicable P45 failure. Chosen after the closed P45/P46 observations. No reserved-scenario request is read.
order_rule: Exactly one run per cell, twelve cells. Task 1: full-contract, selected-names, selected-contract; task 2: selected-names, selected-contract, full-contract; task 3: selected-contract, full-contract, selected-names; task 4: full-contract, selected-contract, selected-names. No outcome-dependent replacement.
display_rule: One-time P44 audited print-origin selection at the boundary. Only recognized documentation return segments in older successful documentation-only stdout are replaced with archive references. Literal labels, actions, metadata, latest turn, mixed outputs, public archives and persistent Python state remain. Both arms share the same omission notice. Later outputs are appended normally.
notification_rule: Both arms receive a fresh ephemeral resource snapshot immediately before each model call. The message accurately describes residual output admission. It is charged as input and is not accumulated in the underlying conversation. No task-specific hints or future-cost predictions.
cache_rule: First continuation call uses cache_prompt=false and must have measured cache_n=0 and prompt_n equal to its full input. Subsequent calls use true. This removes preceding-condition prefix reuse, not all nondeterminism.
budget_rule: Both arms retain 16 calls, 120000 full logical input+output tokens, 480 continuation seconds and original task API caps including the prefix. Count the full input, then output cap=min(4096, remaining_tokens-input_tokens); reject if no output fits or input+cap exceeds the unchanged 65536 context. Display construction, notification, counting, model and tool time belong to continuation. Prefix reconstruction and model loading are separately reported. No free controller model calls.
failure_rule: Unknown model usage/API effects, restoration/cache-policy/runtime/cleanup/evaluation failure or user stop ends the batch without replacement. Ordinary task/budget failure is evaluated and the fixed next cell runs only with the same idle model identity and sufficient finite lease. Record evaluated, unevaluated, not-started cells separately. Never count unknown use as zero.
development_gate: All twelve cells evaluated with known usage and a successful full audit. selected_contract_keep must lose no paired successes versus either full_contract_keep or selected_names_keep, and aggregate continuation logical input+output tokens must be lower than each. Report all cell outcomes, other cost dimensions and failures. Missing usage/evaluation means this gate is not met; no substitution with completed pairs. This is a known-task design decision, not statistical noninferiority, general savings or novelty.
feedback_rule: Only a confirmed undispatched unknown-parameter rejection for an already-exposed API receives the P46 exact public contract or allowed-parameter names. No argument values, new API discovery, automatic correction, retry or new model call. The full-display control receives the identical public-contract feedback. Feedback remains in subsequent ordinary history, is charged as input, and follows the existing output paging rules.
interpretation: Two primary contrasts: selected_contract versus full_contract isolates the display rule under identical repair feedback; selected_contract versus selected_names tests whether the full public contract adds value beyond names. P45 generic rejection is historical context only, not a concurrent causal control. Ordinary masking and detailed validation feedback are not independently new methods; their combination alone does not establish novelty.
